priority_after_source_qualification: COIN-M causal-timing source gate failed. Prepare one separate exploratory price-volume pilot after a frozen causal rule, costs, source manifest, exposure disclosure and reservations; no outcome acquisition in this qualification batch.

price_volume_reserve_qualification.venue: Binance spot, USDT pairs; cash/long-only is the smallest available implementation; no derivative leverage or borrowed short assumed.
price_volume_reserve_qualification.catalog_scope: Four complete names/size catalogs; 110 monthly ZIPs each, 2017-08 through 2026-09. This establishes listed objects, not row completeness or acceptable signal data.
price_volume_reserve_qualification.signed_volume_interpretation: Taker buy volume supports aggressor-signed traded-volume imbalance (2*taker_buy_volume-total_volume); it is not an order-book imbalance or full causal investor-demand measure. Exact transformation and lookback must be frozen before data.
price_volume_reserve_qualification.time_units: Official README: SPOT timestamps before 2025-01-01 are milliseconds; from 2025-01-01 microseconds. Normalize explicitly; no magnitude-based silent repair or same-close decision fill.
price_volume_reserve_qualification.execution_limit: 1m OHLCV are trade prices, not authenticated contemporaneous bid/ask or guaranteed fills. A delayed, conservatively costed price proxy can support an exploratory falsification screen; a positive cannot establish executable alpha without separate quote/latency validation.
price_volume_reserve_qualification.cost_gate: Freeze fee assumptions, spread/slippage central and stress, turnover charges, cash treatment and exposure caps before acquiring outcomes. No fee tier, rebates, BNB discount, zero-fee promotion or historical spread assumed from catalog metadata.
price_volume_reserve_qualification.rights_scope: Vision terms v1.0, 2026-08-26, sections 4.1/4.5: personal non-production non-commercial historical research; derived redistribution credits Binance Vision and keeps CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. No live/commercial permission, account or payment sought.

resources.processing_plan: Stream one archive at a time on existing 2 CPU / 8 GiB environment; reduce minute files to prespecified delayed-entry observations. No RAM-heavy full minute panel or new infrastructure required.

exposure_history.F1: A and B price periods already exposed. A/B/harness unchanged; do not relabel these years as fresh.
exposure_history.B4: Prior macro trend expressions and known selection history stay spent; changing venue/name does not reset equivalent-family history.
exposure_history.public_literature_selection: External prior searches and publication bias remain possible; nine-source review creates a prior, not independent validation.
exposure_history.statistical_budget: Preserve all known trials and atomic reservations; no numerical total inferred while private history is UNKNOWN.

price_volume_reserve_qualification.next_action: Publish one distinct, immutable exploratory hypothesis and source manifest: one trend-plus-signed-volume expression, lagged bounded volatility, delayed trade-price proxy, central/stress costs, fixed beta/ablation comparisons and stop criteria. Count every decision-bearing comparison before results; no grid. Resolve source-only QA gates before calculating returns.
